answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to stake a physically attested optical cross-link key, binding participation to measured wavefront coherence rather than a lagoon of unverifiable claims. Colluding identities that share a tundra of forged keys are exposed when interferometric ranging reveals correlated turbulence signatures, like yarrow. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
